evals.prompt: Use get-pr-ready on https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42. I did not supply a review session.
evals.expected_output: The agent validates host coordination, PR ownership, writable head, and a safe worktree before mutation; creates a dedicated peer task only after the PR exists; sends a self-contained fresh engineering:pr-review request; verifies the native review; loops without polling labels or merging; and stops at an explicit terminal state.

evals.prompt: Use get-pr-ready https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42 --review-session task_abc --max-fix-rounds 3. That task already has unrelated conversation in it.
evals.expected_output: The agent addresses exactly task_abc by stable reference, does not require it to be blank or dedicated, sends a complete request with a unique request_id on every round, accepts only the matching SHA-pinned native review, enforces three accepted must_fix rounds, and never archives the supplied task.

evals.prompt: The peer returned must_fix for the expected SHA, but every finding is disproved by pinned repository evidence and no files need to change.
evals.expected_output: The agent counts the accepted must_fix as a round, posts evidence-based dispositions for only that review, creates no empty commit, resolves only conclusively handled threads, and requests a fresh review of the unchanged SHA.

evals.prompt: While the peer was reviewing, another authorized actor pushed a new commit to the pull request. The peer then returned clean for the old SHA.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the native review and current PR head, discards the stale result without consuming a fix round or fixing the old head, and requests a fresh review for the new current SHA.

evals.prompt: A required focused validation fails after a must_fix change, and the loop:blocked label cannot be written.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not commit or push the unverified change, preserves the worktree, finishes blocked with validation evidence, treats the label failure as a warning only, and keeps an agent-created reviewer task available for resume.

evals.prompt: Use get-pr-ready https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42 --review-session current_task, where current_task is this requesting task's own stable handle.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the self-referential reviewer task before dispatch, does not review inline or deadlock waiting on itself, retries only a genuine setup operation when available, and otherwise finishes blocked without changing PR content.
